notes.title: Merry Christmas! New chapter of Meduziak's adventures is almost complete!
notes.content:
This is my first devlog here, so... first of all... 

Merry Christmas!

I just wanted to give you guys a quick update on the progress on my goofy adventure game Meduziak. Production is going strong! The next chapter of the game is almost complete, and will be coming soon (the early access version should be updated in about a month).

The current state of the new chapter is as follows:
- the episode is fully playable from start to finish,
- all sound effects are implemented,
- music theme is close to completion,
- all animations are ready,
- most of the graphical assets are finished,
- minigames are completed,
- save/load system is working and is compatible with previous save states.

In other words... we are "almost there"! I've attached a few screenshots if you are curious (don't worry - there are no spoilers there). 

See you soon!
Adam / Fieldfare Studios
